error: relative_error_to_full=||R_method-R_full||F/||R_full||F; norm is not squared energy; energy fields are squared

interpretation: rho(T0)>1 obstructs operator Neumann convergence for projected-global feedback; it does not imply singular(I-T0), failure of shifted solve, or explain every residual difference. Local rho<1 does not certify negligible omitted global coupling.
